description.value:
Your transformations grow more potent:

  • Stage 4 (I). Your natural weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage, except against other Therianthropes.
  • Stage 6 (II). Your signature attack deals extra damage equal to your Constitution modifier.
  • Stage 8 (III). The extra damage applies to all your natural weapon attacks while transformed. In addition, when you take the Attack action using Therianthrope natural weapons, you can make one additional natural weapon attack as a Bonus Action.
